expected_invariant: Implemented displacement equals f(k1 r^3 + k2 r^5); first-order bias law with slopes 2 (radius) and 1 (k1); zero bias after correct undistortion inside the fold radius.
experiment: Implementation consistency scan of the displacement; chord bias against the pixel-Jacobian prediction and log-log slopes across image radius and k1; correction with the generating model; fold counterexample with converged undistortion.
failure_modes_checked: markers leaving the image at large shifts
undistorted versus distorted radius when locating the fold

checks.reference: |displacement / f(k1 r^3 + k2 r^5) - 1| on the image x-axis (consistency of observation_camera.distort with its defining formula)

findings.claim: The implemented radial term displaces an on-axis image point by f (k1 r^3 + k2 r^5), as the Brown-Conrady model defines (implementation consistency check)

uncertainty.basis: cancellation in x (1 + k1 r^2) - x at r = 0.02, k1 = 1e-3 (about eps / (k1 r^2))

checks.reference: log-log slope of mean |bias| (k1 = 0.01) against mean image radius minus the predicted 2 (bias ~ J_pix 3 f k1 r^2 dr)
max over shifts of |log-log slope of mean |bias| against |k1| - 1|
all shifted markers visible in both images

generator.name: declared rig, 45 deg helix markers shifted across the image

findings.claim: Uncorrected radial distortion biases chords as J_pix delta_pix to first order: odd and linear in k1 and growing as r^2 with mean image radius

uncertainty.basis: radius slope: largest departure of a pairwise slope from the fitted one (r^4 and perspective terms); first order: the O(k1 r^2) residual itself

checks.reference: chord error after undistortion with the generating model (m)

findings.claim: Undistorting with the true Brown-Conrady model (radial and tangential) removes the chord bias

uncertainty.basis: fixed-point undistortion converged to rounding (60 iterations at contraction below 0.1)

checks.reference: distorted radius at the fold, (2/3)/sqrt(-3 k1), minus the image-corner radius (pixel coordinates are distorted coordinates; negative: fold inside the image)
image fraction beyond the fold circle (pixels without a preimage)
converged fixed-point undistortion (400 iterations) against the monotone-branch preimage r_other

findings.claim: Strong barrel distortion (k1 = -0.6) folds inside the image, so the radial model is not invertible there

counterexample.statement: The Brown-Conrady radial model can be inverted everywhere in the image

uncertainty.basis: fraction: change between 2 px and 4 px pixel sampling; r_other: bisection to adjacent doubles

basis.notes: No lens was measured; higher-order, decentring and temperature effects of real optics are unknown.

findings.claim: A two-term radial plus tangential Brown-Conrady model describes a real lens to the required accuracy

hypothesis: Uncorrected radial distortion displaces pixels by f(k1 r^3 + k2 r^5), producing chord biases that are first order and linear in k1, grow as r^2 with image radius for chords of fixed image extent and vanish when the generating model is inverted; strong barrel distortion makes the model non-invertible inside the image.
input_data: Radial k1 in [-0.1, -0.01, 0.01, 0.1] (k2 = p1 = p2 = 0) for the bias law
Brown-Conrady model (k1, k2, p1, p2) = [0.05, 0.01, 0.0005, -0.0005] for the correction
Displacement scan: 12 radii in [0.02, 0.4], k1 in {1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1} and (k1, k2) = (0.05, 0.02)
Fold at k1 = -0.6, point at undistorted radius 0.85 on the image diagonal
mathematical_model: x_d = x (1 + k1 r^2 + k2 r^4) + [2 p1 x y + p2 (r^2 + 2x^2), p1 (r^2 + 2y^2) + 2 p2 x y]; chord bias ~ J_pix delta_pix with J_pix = d chord / d pixels; only displacement differences (between endpoints, and between cameras through disparity) matter, and for radii differing by dr they are f k1 ((r + dr)^3 - r^3) ~ 3 f k1 r^2 dr (slope 2 in r, 1 in k1). r (1 + k1 r^2) peaks at r = 1/sqrt(-3 k1) with distorted radius (2/3)/sqrt(-3 k1); the fold enters an image of corner radius rho when k1 < -4/(27 rho^2).
numerical_result: formula consistency 9.8e-11; first-order residual 0.30%; bias at k1 = 0.01 grows from 5.91e-06 to 2.18e-04 m, radius slope 2.037 (pairwise 1.996-2.182), k1 slope within 8.0e-05 of 1; corrected error 5.7e-16 m; fold at distorted r = 0.497 < corner 0.533 (1.05% of the image has no preimage); two preimages 514.7 px apart.
observation_model: Noise-free synthetic pixels from distorted cameras triangulated as if undistorted (uncorrected) or after fixed-point undistortion with the true model.

uncertainty: Deterministic; the first-order residual is O(k1 r^2) and bounded by the stated tolerance; the radius slope departs from 2 by the r^4 and perspective terms (pairwise slopes up to 2.18 at the largest radius).
